component.name: farol
component.summary: Launcher for Wayland built with tessela

description.p: A launcher written as a tessela project: one resident process that sleeps while closed, a search core in Rust and a TSX surface. It finds apps, does math and unit conversions, emoji, files in the home directory, clipboard history, open windows, timers and alarms, web searches, bookmarks, quicklinks and aliases.
